links.outcome: Fidelity of synthetic psychiatric data with vs without clinical knowledge retrieval
links.effect: Ablation showed clinical retrieval reliably improved univariate and pairwise fidelity over a no-retrieval LLM.
links.quote: An ablation study shows that clinical retrieval reliably improves univariate and pairwise fidelity over a no-retrieval LLM.

unlisted_practices: Using knowledge-guided RAG to generate privacy-preserving synthetic tabular data without real patient data
Privacy risk assessment of synthetic data (linkage risk, k-map, duplication)

screen.reason: Evaluates RAG knowledge-grounding versus a no-retrieval LLM baseline for generating privacy-preserving synthetic psychiatric data, measuring both data fidelity and privacy/linkage risk.
